portal_description:
Red Hat Storage is software-only, scale-out storage that provides
flexible and affordable unstructured data storage for an enterprise.
GlusterFS, a key building block of Red Hat Storage, is based on a
stackable user-space design and can deliver exceptional performance
for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates various storage servers 
over network interconnections into one large, parallel network 
file system.

This advisory addresses the following bug:

The glusterfs packages have been upgraded to upstream version 3.6.0, 
which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the 
previous version. (BZ#1117999)

Users of glusterfs are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which
adds this enhancement.
